content.short: Trade crypto, borrow against it, or earn from home equity credit pools on Figure Markets, all with self-custody.
content.description: Figure Markets comes from Figure Technologies and runs on Provenance Blockchain. Users trade BTC, ETH and other assets with keys held in MPC wallets rather than by the exchange. Holders can take a loan against their coins at low rates, or earn by funding pools of home equity credit lines and other high-quality loans. Figure also issues YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC. The wider Figure group also offers home equity and DSCR loans, crypto-backed loans and an onchain equity network called OPEN, and Figure Markets' Democratized Prime lets users earn by lending into these credit pools.
